messages:
sarah-ops: quick heads-up — org triage for audit logging coverage gaps across svc layers: api-gw, auth, console, billing, runtime. need to map missing events -> backlog items -> owners. can we do a fast sync? :eyes:
ajay-sec: +1. i have a prioritized list for auth/gw from the KMS/RBAC review. main gap: key rotation events and cross-tenant key access aren’t surfaced to customers.
mike-runtime: runtime is missing some 'model-load' and 'hot-reload' audit events at INFO level. we only emit internal span traces currently.
kate-product: customers keep asking for verbatim user_identity in console audit events (for compliance). we need to decide redaction rules vs customer-facing audit payload.
sarah-ops: good — sketch plan: 1) inventory per service of missing events, 2) schema proposals, 3) field-level sensitivity/redaction rules, 4) KMS/RBAC mapping for key events, 5) backlog tickets and owners. can people volunteer to own their svc inventories?
trent-eng: i’ll own api-gw. will deliver list and proposed schema fields by EOD Wed.
ajay-sec: i’ll own auth + KMS event mapping. question: do we emit KMS key IDs in clear or hashed for customer-facing events? compliance wants deterministic but not raw internal ids. suggestion: HMAC(key_id, customer_salt) or UUID mapping table. thoughts?
kate-product: prefer deterministic masked id (HMAC) so customers can match across streams without exposing internal IDs. add opt-in flag for customers who want raw ids under enterprise contract.
mike-runtime: for runtime model-load, we can emit: {"event":"model_load","model":"<name>","version":"<ver>","tenant":"<tid_hmac>"} and keep KV cache keys redacted. will propose sample schema.
sarah-ops: sample event schema for RBAC changes we want to standardize across services. suggestion: 
```json
{"event":"rbac_change","actor":{"id":"<user_hmac>","role":"admin"},"target":{"type":"key","id":"<key_hmac>"},"action":"grant","src":"console","reason":"support_request"}
```
ajay-sec: +1. also include an optional "evidence" field with length cap for audit trails and a boolean "customer_visible" flag.
audit-bot: automating event-evidence retention policy check: proposed 90d default, extendable with enterprise retention add-on.
trent-eng: two practical constraints: 1) API-GW cannot add heavy JSON parsing at edge — keep primary fields top-level and small; 2) we should version schema with `audit_schema_v` header.
sarah-ops: agreed. action items: trent -> api-gw inventory (due Wed EOD), ajay -> auth + KMS mapping (due Thu), mike -> runtime schema proposals (due Thu), kate -> product decisions on redaction & customer opt-in (due Fri). i'll create backlog tickets and link.
kate-product: one more: customer-facing validation harness — we should provide a small test tool that validates sample events and shows redacted vs raw mappings. i can scope an MVP.
ajay-sec: FYI vuln triage note: we found a path where RBAC role-change events weren’t logged when applied via infra API. adding that to auth backlog.
mike-runtime: quick example edge case: rolling upgrade causes multiple model_load events in quick succession — consider batching or sampling for noisy events (but keep a separate complete ledger for forensics).
sarah-ops: good call. add sampling policy doc to the backlog.
trent-eng: i’ll add a note to the api-gw ticket about rate-limited payloads and event size limits (256KB).
ajay-sec: for KMS integration, we need to log: key_create, key_rotate, key_delete, key_access_attempt (success/fail) with reason codes. include CISA mapping codes where applicable.
sarah-ops: thanks. once inventories land we’ll run a 30-min cross-team sync Friday to align schemas and finalize backlog owners. :thumbsup:
kate-product: thanks all — will prep the validation harness brief and demo stub for Friday.
sarah-ops: closing loop — i’ll post the created backlog links in this thread when done. thanks everyone. :rocket:
